technology_name: Microbial Consortia for Sustainable Waste Management: Tropical Waste Processing Blend
problem_solved: Environmental hazards from waste mismanagement requiring scalable, eco-friendly, and decentralized biological waste processing alternatives.
description: An eco-friendly waste management solution utilizing purpose-driven microbial consortia developed for tropical regions. The technology relies on the large-scale production of tailored microbial blends optimized to treat diverse waste streams via microbial fermentation. Supported by a dedicated repository for consistent inoculant supply, these adaptable blends enable year-round, decentralized zero-waste processing. The initiative replaces conventional chemical treatments with green biotechnology, promoting a circular economy where biowaste is safely converted into resources.
applications:
• Decentralized solid waste management by local municipal bodies and households

• Commercial production and distribution of microbial inoculant blends

• Integration into corporate zero-waste disposal practices and industrial waste treatment

• Generation of rural livelihoods and bio-based enterprise cooperatives for women
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
